experiment: DCF-20 routing in a harder mesh world
base: DCF-15 mesh (units, operators, slow merges, calibrated batch cost model, lambda 0.01) and DCF-19 accounting are unchanged; only the episode generator differs
world_selection: 16 worlds, rho 0.5, 64 episodes each on world-selection seeds; select the world with the largest epoch-oracle headroom over the better fixed operator; committed in world20.json before routing development
policy_selection: single candidate (regime tau, probe delta/phi, escalate delta) with the highest mean objective_total over the dev conditions; strongest_fixed = better of fixed_bp and fixed_exact on dev; both committed in selection20.json before the held-out traces exist

gates.W1: the selected world is materially harder on fresh held-out seeds: mean decision-change rate (exact vs BP) >= 0.05 and mean epoch-oracle headroom over the better fixed operator >= 0.01
gates.R1: selected policy objective_total exceeds the dev-strongest fixed operator in more held-out conditions than it falls below
gates.R2: selected policy exceeds the better of fixed_bp and fixed_exact (chosen per condition with hindsight) in at least half the held-out conditions
